title: When the Postcards Breaks
author: Theo Dunmore
blurb: Ansel Coldharbour, a former prodigy returning to the conservatory as a janitor, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. Then a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must forgive the stranger in the old photographs, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
